ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the horizontal axis is year, from 1950 to 2010; the vertical labeling simultaneously involves "urban population (hundred million)" and "urbanization level (%)". There are four curves in the figure, labeled ①②③④ respectively. ① is located at a relatively high position, with the value roughly rising from above 50% to above 70%; ② is located at a medium position, with the value gradually rising from about 20% to around 40%; ③ and ④ as a whole are in relatively low positions, more like representing changes in the quantity of urban population. Then reason: urbanization level should be expressed as a percentage, therefore it mainly corresponds to the two curves ① and ②. Developed countries started urbanization early and have a high level, so they should correspond to the higher ①; developing countries have a lower urbanization level but continue to rise, so they should correspond to the lower ②. Therefore, the one representing the urbanization level of developing countries is curve ②.

raw_record.question_text:

<image1>

Which curve in the figure represents the urbanization level of developing countries?

method.method_draft: Describe the graph axes and curves. Identify which curves can represent urbanization level rather than urban population: the two percentage-like curves are ① and ②. Compare them using geographic knowledge: developed countries should be the higher urbanization-level curve, so ① is developed countries' urbanization level; the lower but steadily increasing percentage curve is developing countries' urbanization level. Therefore choose curve ②.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中横轴是年份，从1950到2010；纵向标注同时涉及“城市人口（亿）”和“城市化水平（%）”。图内有四条曲线，分别标为①②③④。①位于较高位置，数值大致从50%以上上升到70%以上；②位于中等位置，数值从约20%逐步上升到40%左右；③和④整体处在较低位置，更像表示城市人口数量的变化。再推理：城市化水平应表现为百分比，因此主要对应①和②两条曲线。发达国家城市化起步早、水平高，应对应较高的①；发展中国家城市化水平较低但持续上升，应对应较低的②。因此，表示发展中国家城市化水平的是第②条曲线。
